goal: Add slope-driven rock and seasonal woodland ground litter without adding per-patch sprites

materials.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable ground albedo texture for the existing top-down 2.5D Piedmont woodland survival game. Create one square, edge-to-edge material swatch of exposed weathered Piedmont bedrock on a steep ridge: broad irregular plates of gray-brown gneiss and weathered metamorphic stone, subtle fine mineral banding, small embedded pale quartz flecks, sparse dark soil in hairline cracks, very little vegetation. Keep stone shapes dense and medium-small so the repeated texture reads naturally at game scale. Palette muted cool slate-gray, warm taupe, subdued charcoal; restrained contrast matching the existing dirt and gravel materials. Soft naturalistic painted game-art detail, orthographic straight overhead, flat even diffuse lighting. The opposing edges must tile seamlessly. Entire square filled uniformly. No perspective, cast shadows, vignette, borders, large isolated boulders, plants, leaves, wood, water, text, labels, watermark or transparency. This is a reusable texture swatch, not a landscape. Square 1024 by 1024 composition.
